title: Statistical Estimation
curriculum_locator: Stat H-201 Statistical Estimation; University of Dhaka four-year B.S. Honours Statistics curriculum, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Foundations of Point Estimation, Unbiasedness & Minimum Variance Criteria
scope: Parameter spaces, estimators as measurable statistics, sampling distributions
Bias function, unbiased estimators, non-existence of unbiased estimators in bounded domains
Mean Squared Error (MSE) decomposition and variance-bias trade-off
Pitman closeness criterion and comparison of competing point estimators
Uniformly Minimum Variance Unbiased Estimators (UMVUE) concept and definitions

units.title: Cramér–Rao Inequality, Fisher Information & Efficiency
scope: Regularity conditions for information inequalities and score functions
First and second Bartlett identities and Fisher Information
Cauchy-Schwarz derivation of the Cramér–Rao Lower Bound (CRLB)
Multiparameter Fisher Information matrix and vector CRLB
Attainment conditions for CRLB and Bhattacharyya higher-order bounds

units.title: Sufficiency, Completeness & the Rao–Blackwell and Lehmann–Scheffé Theorems
scope: Neyman-Fisher Factorization Theorem and minimal sufficiency
Completeness, bounded completeness, and completeness in exponential families
Basu's Theorem on independence of complete sufficient statistics and ancillary statistics
The Rao-Blackwell Theorem and conditional expectation improvement
The Lehmann-Scheffé Theorem and uniqueness of UMVUEs

units.title: Methods of Point Estimation: Method of Moments & Maximum Likelihood
scope: Method of Moments (MOM): population vs sample moments, consistency, and limitations
Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE): likelihood equations and global concavity
Boundary solutions and non-regular MLEs (Uniform, shifted Exponential)
Invariance property of Maximum Likelihood Estimators (Zeena's Theorem)
Numerical algorithms: Newton-Raphson, Fisher scoring, and EM algorithm

units.title: Asymptotic Properties of Maximum Likelihood Estimators
scope: Weak and strong consistency of MLEs and Wald's consistency conditions
Asymptotic normality: root-n convergence and limiting Gaussian distributions
Asymptotic efficiency and attainment of Cramér-Rao lower bound in the limit
Observed vs Expected Fisher Information in variance estimation
Sandwich covariance matrix and robustness under model misspecification

units.title: Interval Estimation: Pivotal Quantities & Exact Confidence Sets
scope: Definition of confidence intervals, coverage probability, and confidence coefficients
Pivotal quantity method for constructing exact confidence sets
Exact confidence intervals for normal mean (known and unknown variance, Student's t)
Exact confidence intervals for normal variance and ratio of variances (Chi-square and F)
Two-sample confidence intervals and the Behrens-Fisher problem (Welch-Satterthwaite)

units.title: Approximate and Asymptotic Confidence Intervals
scope: Large-sample interval estimation via asymptotic normality and Slutsky's Theorem
Wald confidence intervals, Score (Wilson) intervals, and Likelihood Ratio intervals
Confidence intervals for binomial proportions and Poisson arrival rates
Confidence intervals for non-linear parameters via the Delta Method
Bootstrap confidence intervals: percentile, basic, and studentized bootstrap

units.title: Bayesian Estimation & Decision-Theoretic Foundations
scope: Prior distributions: subjective, conjugate, non-informative, and Jeffreys invariant priors
Bayes' theorem for continuous parameter spaces and posterior distribution derivations
Decision theory: loss functions (squared error, absolute error, zero-one, LINEX)
Bayes point estimators (posterior mean, posterior median, posterior mode)
Credible intervals: equal-tailed credible intervals vs Highest Posterior Density (HPD) regions
